tagline: Treehouses and suites in forest beside Volcanoes National Park.
description:
One&Only Gorilla's Nest stands at Nyonirima, in Kinigi, on the edge of Volcanoes National Park in Rwanda. The address region is given as Ruhengeri. The stay is built around the forest and around treks to the mountain gorillas. Telephone reservations are +250 221 011 111, and the reservations desk is reservations@oneandonlygorillasnest.com.

Accommodation is a set of treehouses and suites. The Forest Treehouse is 77 square metres for two guests, with an open-air viewing deck and an outdoor shower. The Susa Treehouse is 87 square metres, with two bedrooms, a viewing deck and a fireplace, for three guests. The Virunga Suite is 147 square metres, with floor-to-ceiling glass and an open-air bathtub. The Ingagi Suite is 251 square metres, with an outdoor bath and shower and a deck. The Silverback Suite is 402 square metres, with an open-air lounge, a firepit and a private pool.

The Nest serves seasonal menus that change daily. Club One, overlooking the pool and gardens, serves a lighter menu of smoothies, salads and simple dishes. The kitchen garden grows flowers, vegetables and herbs used in the cooking, and dinner can also be taken there or in the library, which has a fireplace. The former residence of the wildlife presenter Jack Hanna is now a cottage used for private meals.

Gorilla treks are arranged into Volcanoes National Park. The experiences pages also point guests toward Rwandan cultural visits and the forest around the lodge. The One&Only Spa is on the property. A second Kerzner stay, Nyungwe Tea Forest Resort, sits on a working tea estate at the edge of an ancient rainforest, for guests who continue further into Rwanda.

One&Only Gorilla's Nest suits travellers coming to Kinigi for gorilla trekking who want a forest suite or treehouse, a small number of dining rooms, and a private pool only in the largest suite.
